brief: A haunting airborne ice manta, wide flattened diamond silhouette with two immense swept fins and a long narrow split tail, no legs. Navy upper body, ivory underside, opaque milky ice edging on fins, narrow cyan eyes, two short horn-like cephalic lobes. Slight hovering bank in neutral pose, head pointing left, visibly winglike fins yet unmistakably ray anatomy. Only three contained ice motes nearby, no mist or backdrop.

construction.parts: head/body, two fins, cephalic lobes, tail segments, three detached motes
